    int l = s.length();
    int c = 0, z, j;
    for (int i = 0; i < l - 1; ) {
        if (s[i] == s[i+1]) {
            z = 1;

                if (s[j] == s[j+1])

            }
            if (z % 2 == 0)

            i = j;
        } else {
            i++;
        }
    }
    cout << c << endl;
    return 0;
}
